title: Sell Mineral Rights in Valdez, CO
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Valdez, CO | Las Animas County
metaDescription: Valdez sits in rural Raton Basin country near Trinidad, with coal and CBM history layered together. Get a title-checked offer on your interest.
heroLead: Valdez is small, rural Raton Basin ground where the coal camp history and the coalbed methane history run through the same deed books.
intro: A small unincorporated community south of Trinidad, Valdez sits inside the same Raton Basin coal and coalbed methane district that shaped much of southern Las Animas County. Mineral ownership here typically traces back to the same mining-era conveyances that split coal and gas rights across the region, so a careful title check matters as much as the geology when we're figuring out what your interest is worth.
Because Valdez is so small, most local mineral transactions we handle involve interests that have been passed down without ever being actively managed by the family.

sections.heading: A quiet corner of an already mature basin
paragraphs: Raton Basin CBM activity around Valdez has always been lighter than the areas closer to Trinidad's core, and what wells exist here are largely mature, low-decline producers rather than recent completions. That gives us a longer, steadier production history to price against, even though overall well density in this specific area is modest.

sections.heading: Coal and gas rights, often held separately
paragraphs: Like much of southern Las Animas County, coal and oil and gas rights around Valdez were frequently severed at different points in history, sometimes to different owners. We confirm which estate, or estates, you actually hold through the Las Animas County Clerk and Recorder before quoting a value.

sections.heading: What determines your offer
paragraphs: Production history on any existing well tied to your unit, your confirmed fractional interest, and comparable recent Las Animas County sales all factor into the number we bring you.

faqs.question: Is there active drilling near Valdez right now?
faqs.answer: Activity in this part of the Raton Basin is mature rather than new, mostly long-running, low-decline CBM production.

faqs.question: How do I know if I hold coal or gas rights, or both?
faqs.answer: We trace your deed history through Las Animas County records to confirm exactly which estate your ownership covers.

faqs.question: What if my interest has never produced?
faqs.answer: We can still make an offer, priced against the likelihood of future inclusion in a unit rather than current cash flow.

faqs.question: Nobody in my family has managed this interest in decades. Is that a problem?
faqs.answer: No, an unmanaged interest is common, especially in small rural communities like Valdez. We simply confirm current ownership through the county record before making an offer.
